page.overview:
Who is Z'dak?

Z'dak is a minor character in the television series Mortal Kombat: Conquest, portrayed by former professional wrestler Fred "Typhoon" Ottman.

Z'dak is a warrior and the mining leader of the Cobalt Mines of Shokan in Outworld. When he saw Shang Tsung in the Mines, he aggressively confronted Shang for encroaching on his territory. Shortly after, he was killed by the sorcerer.
